title: PyTorch for Python Developers
description: A focused, hands-on introduction to PyTorch for engineers already comfortable with Python and NumPy. Two compact modules: the tensor + autograd foundation, then a minimal training loop end-to-end.

modules.title: Tensors and Autograd Foundations
modules.summary: Anchor PyTorch on what the learner already knows from NumPy, then introduce the one feature that makes it different: autograd. Closes with how device placement (CPU vs CUDA) shapes everyday code.

lessons.title: Devices: CPU, CUDA, and Tensor Placement

modules.title: A Minimal Training Loop
modules.summary: Compose a working training pipeline from the primitives in Module 1: an `nn.Module` model, a loss, an optimizer, and the canonical six-line training step.
